Our exposure to credit risk comes mostly from client transactions in OTC derivatives and loans and lending commitments. We conduct regular stress tests to calculate the credit exposures, including potential concentrations that would result from applying shocks to counterparty credit ratings or credit risk factors (e.g., currency rates, interest rates, equity prices).
